notes: Use a Nol card for the metro (Red Line from the airport to the Marina). Taxis are cheap and reliable (Careem/Uber). The E100 bus to Abu Dhabi costs 25 AED.

Summer brings 42-45°C and humidity: stay indoors between 10:00 and 17:00 (malls, museums, water parks). Go to the beach at 07:00 or in the evening. During Ramadan, eating and drinking in the daytime is only allowed in enclosed areas.
Mosque visits require long sleeves and a headscarf; abayas are provided at Sheikh Zayed. Alcohol is served only in licensed hotels and restaurants.
Burj Khalifa sunset tickets sell out weeks ahead, and so do Museum of the Future tickets.
Old Dubai is cheap and authentic: abra 1 AED, Al Ustad kebab 60 AED. Downtown and the Marina are expensive.
A 10% tip is common. Haggling is essential in the souks: start at half the asking price.

transit.name: Nol Card
transit.why_chosen: Valid on the metro, tram, buses and abra. The Silver card is the most practical.
transit.coverage: Dubai Metro, tram, RTA otobüs, su otobüsü, abra
transit.where_to_buy: Metro istasyonları; 25 AED (6 AED bakiye dahil)

stops.name: Dubai Mall
stops.tips: The world's largest shopping mall, with an aquarium and ice rink. An air-conditioned start to the day.

stops.name: Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo
stops.tips: A tunnel aquarium inside the mall, with sharks.

stops.name: Social House Dubai Mall
stops.tips: International menu with fountain views. Lunch stop.

stops.name: Burj Khalifa At the Top
stops.tips: Floors 124-125, sunset slot (~219 AED). Book online weeks ahead. You get sunset and the city lights in one visit.

stops.name: Dubai Fountain
stops.tips: A fountain show every 30 minutes on Burj Lake. Watch for free from the Souk Al Bahar terrace.

backups.name: Time Out Market Dubai
backups.tips: Food hall at Souk Al Bahar. Lunch with plenty of choice.

backups.name: Sky Views Observatory
backups.tips: Glass walkway facing the Burj. A backup if Burj tickets are unavailable.

days.theme: Old Dubai: Al Fahidi, abra and souks

stops.name: Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood
stops.tips: Stone houses with wind towers. Have breakfast at Arabian Tea House and visit the coffee museum. Mornings are cool.

stops.name: Dubai Museum Al Shindagha
stops.tips: Pearl-diving history and a Creek museum in Shindagha. Air-conditioned.

stops.name: Dubai Creek Abra
stops.tips: Cross to Deira by wooden boat for 1 AED. One of the cheapest and best moments in Dubai.

stops.name: Deira Spice Souk
stops.tips: Spices, saffron and incense. Haggling is a must; paying half the asking price is normal.

stops.name: Al Ustad Special Kabab
stops.tips: Iranian kebabs since 1978, in Bur Dubai, with walls full of photos. Dubai's most famous cheap eatery.

backups.name: Arabian Tea House Al Fahidi
backups.tips: Emirati breakfast or lunch in a courtyard.

backups.name: Deira Gold Souk
backups.tips: The gold market. Browse the windows; it is next to the Spice Souk.

stops.name: Aquaventure Waterpark Atlantis
stops.tips: A huge water park on the Palm, the only cure for summer heat. Buy tickets online; mornings are less crowded.

stops.name: Jumeirah Mosque
stops.tips: Mosque tour at 14:00, guided by SMCCU.

stops.name: Al Fanar Restaurant Jumeirah
stops.tips: A 1960s-themed Emirati restaurant. Try the machboos and luqaimat.

stops.name: Madinat Jumeirah Souk
stops.tips: An artificial souk with canals. The abra tour costs 100 AED, with sunset views of the Burj Al Arab.

stops.name: Burj Al Arab Viewpoint
stops.tips: Sunset view of the sail-shaped hotel from Jumeirah Beach. Free.

backups.name: Pierchic Madinat
backups.tips: A pier restaurant over the sea. A special dinner.

backups.name: Etihad Museum
backups.tips: Museum on the founding of the UAE. Air-conditioned.

stops.name: Dubai Marina Walk
stops.tips: A marina promenade among skyscrapers. Stop for coffee.

stops.name: The View at The Palm
stops.tips: Observation terrace on floor 52 of Palm Jumeirah. You can see the palm shape from here.

stops.name: Nakheel Mall
stops.tips: The Palm's mall. An air-conditioned break.

stops.name: Bu Qtair Jumeirah
stops.tips: A former fishermen's shack turned legend. Fried fish of the day, eaten standing or on stools.

stops.name: JBR The Walk & Beach
stops.tips: The JBR seafront strip. Swim in winter, take an evening walk in summer, with views of Ain Dubai.

backups.name: Ain Dubai
backups.tips: The world's largest observation wheel. If the weather is clear.

stops.name: Museum of the Future
stops.tips: The museum of the future, a giant ring with Arabic calligraphy. Buy online tickets weeks ahead.

stops.name: Dubai Frame
stops.tips: A golden frame separating old and new Dubai. Glass bridge, air-conditioned.

stops.name: Ravi Restaurant Satwa
stops.tips: Pakistani cuisine and Dubai's most famous cheap eatery. Order the dal and chicken karahi.

stops.name: Lahbab Desert Safari
stops.tips: In summer, go on an evening safari after 17:00 when the sand is hot. Show and BBQ, 250-400 AED.

backups.name: Al Mallah Satwa
backups.tips: Lebanese shawarma and fruit cocktails. An alternative to Ravi.

backups.name: Al Qudra Lakes
backups.tips: Artificial lakes and flamingos in the desert. Go by car instead of the safari.

stops.name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
stops.tips: 1.5 hours from Dubai (E100 bus, 25 AED). See the world's largest carpet and chandeliers, free entry. Online registration is required; an abaya is provided at the entrance.

stops.name: Louvre Abu Dhabi
stops.tips: Jean Nouvel's rain-of-light dome on Saadiyat Island. Air-conditioned.

stops.name: Louvre Abu Dhabi Cafe
stops.tips: Lunch in the museum cafe, beneath the dome.

stops.name: Qasr Al Watan
stops.tips: The presidential palace, with white marble and a library.

stops.name: Abu Dhabi Corniche
stops.tips: The seafront promenade. Your return bus leaves at 18:30.

backups.name: Emirates Palace Le Café
backups.tips: Gold-flecked cappuccino in the palace hotel.

backups.name: Yas Island Ferrari World
backups.tips: The world's fastest roller coaster. An alternative to the palace.

stops.name: Alserkal Avenue
stops.tips: An art gallery district in Al Quoz. Coffee and exhibitions, free.

stops.name: Karama Market
stops.tips: Souvenirs and textiles. Haggle.

stops.name: Logma Boxpark
stops.tips: A modern Emirati cafe. Try regag bread (thin Emirati flatbread) and karak tea for a farewell meal.

stops.name: Dubai Metro Red Line Airport
stops.tips: Take the metro to DXB Terminals 1-3. Farewell.

backups.name: Karak House Jumeirah
backups.tips: Karak tea and Emirati breakfast. A light farewell.

backups.name: Jameel Arts Centre
backups.tips: Contemporary art by the Creek. An alternative to Alserkal.
